newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Speedway buys Phoenix Int'l Raceway.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Speedway buys Phoenix Int'l Raceway.

text.p: International Speedway Corp said it bought the Phoenix International Raceway, a 65,000-seat one-mile oval track.
International Speedway bought the track from Emmett "Buddy" Jobe, who had owned and operated the track since 1985, for $46.1 million plus applicable taxes.

The estimated total amount of all of the payments, which will be made in several installments in 1998 and 1999, including the initial $46.1 million, will be between $60 and $67 million, depending on how much tax is ultimately paid on the transaction.

The company said it planned to add an additional 25,000 seats to the Phoenix race track. After the completion, International Speedway said it will have more than 400,000 seats available at its five largest motorsports facilities.
The company's stock closed at 21-2/8 Monday.
